value.body: Assistant is the clerical-level post at the Reserve Bank of India's regional offices. Assistants handle office and banking-operations work — currency management, accounts, public grievances and administrative support. Recruitment is state-wise, tied to each regional office.

items.label: Education
items.note: Pass class for SC/ST/PwBD; working knowledge of computers

items.label: Selection stages
items.note: The LPT in the state's official / local language is qualifying

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree with the required marks and proficiency in the language of the state you apply in. RBI issues its own notification (conducted online); you apply for one regional office only.

value.title: At a glance
items: Vacancies are limited and spread across regional offices, with the largest share usually in Mumbai.
The language test is mandatory — candidates who fail it are not selected even after clearing mains.
Promotion to officer grades comes through internal selection over time; eligible Assistants can also take the open RBI Grade B exam.
